Name: Funnel Metric
Expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(Funnel[Stage]),
    "Product Views", [Viewed Customers],
    "Add To Cart", [Cart Customers],
    "Checkouts", [Checkout Customers],
    "Purchases", [Purchased Customers]
)

Name: Cart Customers
Expression:
VAR ViewSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "view_product"
    )
VAR CartSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "add_to_cart"
    )
RETURN
COUNTROWS(INTERSECT(ViewSet, CartSet))

Name: Checkout Customers
Expression:
VAR ViewSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "view_product"
    )
VAR CartSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "add_to_cart"
    )
VAR CheckoutSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "checkout"
    )
RETURN
COUNTROWS(INTERSECT(INTERSECT(ViewSet, CartSet), CheckoutSet))

Name: Purchased Customers
Expression:
VAR ViewSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "view_product"
    )
VAR CartSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "add_to_cart"
    )
VAR CheckoutSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "checkout"
    )
VAR PurchaseSet =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(sessions[customer_id]),
        sessions[event_type] = "purchase"
    )
RETURN
COUNTROWS(INTERSECT(INTERSECT(INTERSECT(ViewSet, CartSet), CheckoutSet), PurchaseSet))
